pr_body:
By increasing the voting duration in case of high
delays, to avoid the possible endless repetition
of voting rounds.

Fixes #89867

review_comment: If we aren't going to make `delayVariabilityMillis` bigger, could you extend this comment to mention that elections could take even longer than `delayVariabilityMillis` but in practice this is long enough to avoid bad collisions with very high probability?
